caption: The video showcases a brass clock movement mounted on the upper part of a vertical wooden board against a pale wall, with a thin pendulum rod and round brass bob hanging below. The pendulum is already swinging as the clip opens. The bob drifts from near its left extreme toward the right, reaches its rightmost position around the middle, then reverses and sweeps leftward to its leftmost extreme. The rod tilts in the same direction as the bob, and the small crutch lever at its top shifts left and right in step with the swing. The toothed gear wheels within the brass plates shift only subtly, while the board and wall marks stay fixed. As the clip closes, the bob is again moving rightward, the oscillation still underway.
relations: The swinging pendulum bob moves horizontally between left and right extremes, reversing at each end.
The thin rod tilts in sync with the bob, pivoting near the top crutch.
The crutch lever at the rod's top shifts left and right matching the bob's swing.
The brass gear wheels turn subtly while the wooden board and wall marks remain fixed.
